channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jarrett Allen | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jarrett Allen from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Evan Mobley on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
‪NBA‬: Evan Mobley on Jarrett Allen’s showing in Game 7:

“He seemed like he was locked in from the jump. He just kept rebounding the ball every single chance he got.”

Evan Mobley on Jarrett Allen, May 4, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Evan Mobley on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
#Cavs Evan Mobley on overcoming Jarrett Allen's continued absence:

“Without another big out there I have to hold it down until he gets back. That’s what I tried to do tonight, and I feel like I’ve been doing a pretty good job so far.”

Evan Mobley on Jarrett Allen, Mar 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
“You always look back on it like, ‘Man, should we have (given a player more rest)?’ This is more of a contact thing (with Allen). The soft tissue is one of the ones where you’re like, ‘That’s overuse.’”

Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen, Mar 4, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: John Wall on Donovan Mitchell, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Evan Mobley
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: John Wall on the Cavs:

“I think they gotta make a big change. Donovan Mitchell, Darius Garland are just not getting along in that backcourtand I think with Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley they're just too soft”

John Wall on Donovan Mitchell, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Evan Mobley, Dec 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Evan Mobley on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
“Jarrett can be down in the dunker spot. It creates space for our offense to really run and do what we want to.”

Evan Mobley on Jarrett Allen, Oct 3, 2024. Source: Fear the sword.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen:

“Every day, he tries to do more and more and test the mobility. That's where we'll get the signs ... of when he'll be able to play ... we're not gonna put him out there if he can't protect himself and that's where he's been at to this point.”

JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen, May 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
#CavsJ.B. Bickerstaff on who starts for injured Jarrett Allen tonight:

“I'm not sure yet (laughs and smiles). I got no clue what I'm doing”

JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen, Oct 25, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Tim Bontemps on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
“If you say they need to move away from the two-big lineup, part of the issue Cleveland has and a lot of these teams with talented centers have is there are so many centers in the league right now. If you have a guy like Jarrett Allen, who is really good, and you want to turn him into something else, it is very hard to get even value for him,”

Tim Bontemps on Jarrett Allen, Jul 26, 2023. Source: Cavs Nation.

item.title: Tim Bontemps on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
ESPN’s Tim Bontemps said.

“Which is where it comes back to if you are the Cavs, you really need Evan Mobley to take this step forward so you don’t have to do that and then sacrifice and get 60-70% of the talent level of Jarrett Allen to balance out your roster.”

Tim Bontemps on Jarrett Allen, Jul 26, 2023. Source: Cavs Nation.

item.title: Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Jarrett Allen, Isaac Okoro
item.description:
“They don’t got Jarrett Allen. They don’t got [Isaac] Okoro. We don’t got [Julius Randle].Maybe some of the individual things you see on both sides and you get a feel for it. But I think both teams are going to play totally different.”

Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Jarrett Allen, Isaac Okoro, Apr 1, 2023. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: LeBron James on Kevin Love, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland
item.description:
“I think big fella (Allen), that acquisition was amazing for them to make that trade. Obviously Darius Garland is a big-time player. And I think the role that Kevin (Love) is playing right now has kind of uplifted those young guys, seeing a veteran that could sacrifice, a champion that’s won a championship, all the things that he’s done, to come off the bench and play this role. I am not surprised by anything that they’re doing right now.”

LeBron James on Kevin Love, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Feb 19, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen, Collin Sexton
item.description:
#CavsJ.B. Bickerstaff on the verbal spat between Sexton & Allen:

“I don’t think it was that big of a deal. We discussed it and we moved on. If you never have conflict, you never have resolution. So it’s OK to have a little bit of conflict as long as it leads to a resolution.”

JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen, Collin Sexton, Feb 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
#Cavs J.B. Bickerstaff on going Allen over Drummond late

“Decisions come down to in that moment & what I think is the best move for the group. I thought Jarrett was playing really well with the way he was protecting the paint & the way he was rebounding & his ability to switch”

JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen, Jan 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Steve Nash on Joe Harris, Jarrett Allen
item.description:
“Ky is a weapon off the ball. Kevin can play all five positions and I plan to use him in all five positions. I get excited to use some of the guys on the roster Caris, DJ, Jarrett Allen, Joe Harris,”

Steve Nash on Joe Harris, Jarrett Allen, Sep 17, 2020. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Tyler Johnson on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
Nets guard Tyler Johnson said of Toronto’s elite protect the paint defence.

“They’re usually bringing three or four guys into the paint. We got into a timeout in the third quarter and I looked at J.A. (Jarrett Allen)and told him how unselfish he was being throughout the entire game because a guy of his caliber could easily be frustrated and angry and be more demonstrative about not getting field goal attempts, but the guy continued to screen, continued to get guys open, continued to get offensive boards. You know, you can find yourself just going up and taking shots off of those, (but) he continued to kick it out, continued to make the right basketball play,”

Tyler Johnson on Jarrett Allen, Aug 22, 2020. Source: Toronto Sun.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Joel Embiid, Jarrett Allen
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Dudley on Embiid laughing off the flagrant to Jarett Allen:

“I felt a certain type of way because you’re laughing & someone could've really gotten hurt. Luckily Jay did pop up. That's been Embiid’s personality but just because it’s your personality doesn’t mean it’s right.”

Jared Dudley on Joel Embiid, Jarrett Allen, Apr 17, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
“I look at [Clint] Capela, and you can’t tell me Jarrett can’t be just as good if not better than Capela. I think his shot blocking is already better than Capela right now,”

Jared Dudley on Jarrett Allen, Apr 15, 2019. Source: SLAM.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
Atkinson on Jarrett Allen:

“If you’re going to go to the rim and protect the rim, you’re going to get dunked on once in a while. But it speaks to his character, to me; because there are a lot of guys in this league, they get out of the way. They don’t want any part of it.”

Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen, Jan 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jahlil Okafor, Jarrett Allen
item.description:
Kerber asked Atkinson if Okafor's presence would mean less time for Allen.

“No. (We could play) Jarrett and Okafor together. Put Okafor at the 5,”

Kenny Atkinson on Jahlil Okafor, Jarrett Allen, Dec 30, 2017. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
“I’ve known that since training camp that he’s going to contribute right away. I thought in the beginning [he’d be in] G-League. That was before we discovered who he is. I like his basketball IQ. I like his toughness. Love went at him twice and scored, and then [Allen] came back and blocked his shot. He didn’t back down. Yes, I think if he stays healthy, he’s going to be a contributor to this team.”

Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen, Nov 24, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
The way Allen has played since returning to action — and the way the Nets have struggled for a solution at center — it’s apparent he’s going to have to start playing extended minutes, sooner rather than later.

“Jarrett came in and gave us a nice boost, good energy off the bench. Yeah, I was proud of his competitive grit,”

Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen, Nov 24, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:Atkinson on J. Allen:

“There's two things... The rim protection. And then, I think this is rare for bigs, but he can switch on to guards.”

Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen, Oct 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.
